title: spec(object-timeline): `items` still says "the author owns the item shape" — objectui#6356 declared the timeline element (feed | gantt, judged by `variant`)
body:
Filing-gate category: ④ a cross-repo child — the objectstack half of objectui#6356, filed by the seat that accepted its objectui PR (cross-repo rule 3: an accepted PR whose product flows into another repo gets its follow-up in the consuming repo at once). Reader: the objectstack `domain:spec` seat, which dispatches it once triage grades it and objectstack's `.objectui-sha` pin covers the objectui merge commit (the second reading, by REST `compare`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat #1 @ objectui, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`. ⛔ Not graded here.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#10822

## What landed in objectui (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10822, `Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#6356`, merged 2026-09-27 as objectui `3a5817f07`)

Maintainer ruling on objectui#6356, Q1 = A and Q2 = C:

- `@object-ui/types` `TimelineSchema.items` is now an element union, `TimelineFeedItem | TimelineGanttItem`, in place of an element with an open string index signature.
  - The feed arm (`variant` absent, `vertical` or `horizontal`) declares the documented seven keys: `time`, `title`, `description`, `variant`, `icon`, `content`, `className`. `title` is required.
  - The gantt arm (`variant: 'gantt'`) is a row: `label` is required, and `items` holds bars (`title`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `variant`).
- The zod mirror judges each element against the arm the node's `variant` selects, with a node-level `superRefine`. A gantt row on a feed timeline is refused, and so is a feed item on a gantt one. The published `TimelineSchema` stays a `ZodObject`.
- The strict authoring face refuses undeclared keys by name (`meta`, `group`, `color`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `_data`, `date`). The tolerant face keeps `.passthrough()`.
- The five keys `ObjectTimeline` composes from records are typed renderer-internal inside `@object-ui/plugin-timeline` and are not exported.
- objectui's `object-timeline` renderer types its schema as `TimelineSchema & { … }` (`packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` `ObjectTimelineProps`). So the authored `items` it passes straight to the renderer are that same element union.

## What the spec says today (objectstack `origin/main` `1207baf0`)

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:4400`, in `ObjectTimelinePropsSchema`:

- `items: z.array(z.unknown()).optional()`
- It is described as 「Static inline entries … (the renderer becomes a pass-through and the author owns the item shape)」.

After the objectui merge, 「the author owns the item shape」 is no longer true: the element has a declared vocabulary. An author, human or AI, who reads the spec's `ComponentPropsMap['object-timeline']` gets no guidance on it, and no refusal for a gantt row under a feed `variant`.

## Direction (sequencing only, ⛔ not a shape ruling)

Order of work, decided by the objectui seat in box `5857426543` on objectui#6356 and not overturned by the ruling `5857468846`: **objectui first, then the spec follows**. The element's implementation, docs and only producer live in objectui.

Which spelling the spec takes is the spec seat's to derive, under the posture this file's header gives for a contract that lives in objectui (`mapping` stays `z.unknown()` for that reason). The candidates:

- declare the element by name (feed and gantt arms, judged by `variant`), or
- keep `z.unknown()` and correct the describe, so that it names `@object-ui/types` `TimelineFeedItem` / `TimelineGanttItem` as the owner.

Either way, the pinned read points (`:546` `if (schema.items) return schema.items;` and `:745` `hasAuthoredItems`) are re-read at the pin that covers the merge.

- `TimelineFeedItem` / `TimelineGanttItem` → 0
